title: 第012章 一楼大厅第013章 面见大师姐
content_zh:
;;
云梦蝶说道：“那你帮我打一个电话，就说我云梦蝶带着一个乞丐要见她！”
前台小姐心中奇怪；“好像是听说过总裁要找一名乞丐，难道就是这位？”
想到这里，不敢迟疑，跑步进了前台，用座机拨打了总裁办公室电话。
此时的吴茉莉正坐在办公桌里发愁；“紫嫣，你说，我小师弟到底去了哪里？为何就不来找我呢？”
刘紫嫣微微一笑，“总裁，不要着急，这才过了一个晚上，说不定今天不知道什么时候就来了，你也不要发愁了，身体要紧！”
“唉！”
吴茉莉叹了口气：“紫嫣，你可不知道，当初我们师姐弟们下山，都没有给1分钱，想必小师弟这一次也会如此，怎么能叫我不担心？”
两人正说着，总裁办公桌上的座机响了起来。
刘紫嫣上前拿起了话筒：“喂！这里是总裁办公室！我是刘紫嫣。”
话筒里传来了前台小姐的声音：“刘秘书长，梦蝶集团总裁云梦蝶小姐说，她带着一个乞丐要见董事长！”
“让他们上来。哦，不，我亲自下来迎接，好生招待，不可以得罪！”刘紫嫣有些激动的说道。
刘紫嫣挂断电话，急忙说道：“总裁，梦蝶集团总裁云梦蝶小姐，带着一名乞丐说要见你，我想，肯定是你的小师弟，我现在就去把她们接上来！”
吴茉莉也是一脸的激动，“好！”
刘紫嫣没有迟疑，直接走出了办公室。
一楼大厅。
此时，一名业务组长从外面走了进来。
“哟！这不是梦蝶集团总裁吗？怎么今天有时间到我们龙威集团来了？”这名业务组长阴阳怪气的说道。
云梦蝶看了他一眼，冰冷的说道：“我来不来跟你有半毛钱关系？你不要脸的流氓，管得着吗？”
听见云梦蝶这么骂这名业务组长，秦延军看了她一眼，二十五六的样子，皮肤倒是长的白净，但是，五官有点不成正比。

然后对云梦蝶说道：“云小姐，不必要理会这种人，看样子就是一个人渣。”
业务组长看见一个乞丐这么说自己，怒火上升：“一个臭乞丐敢这么说我，你是找死吗？知道这是哪里吗？”
话音刚落，抬步就走上前来，扬起手掌就要照着秦延军的脸打下去。
云梦蝶一个箭步冲了上去：“你敢！知道你这一巴掌落下去，你会有什么样的后果吗？”
听到这句话，业务组组长的手收了回来：“我申友军好歹也是龙威集团的一个业务部组长，难道我在这里打一个人，还有人敢把我怎么样？”
正在这时，两位美女从外面走了进来。
“申组长，在龙威集团大厅，你还敢行凶？就不怕被总裁知道吗？”来人正是给秦延军暗中送钱买盒饭的两名美女，刘晓燕和林小倩两人。她们一进门就看见申友军举起手要打人，随后又说出那番话。随后又看见了秦延军，所以才呵斥申友军。
申友军一看是自己手下的业务员，“原来是你们两个，今天这么大胆，敢呵斥我，是不是不想要工作了？我一句话就能让你们丢掉饭碗。也是看你们两个长的漂亮，兴许哪一天就是我的人了？所以才留你们到今天，要不然早就让你们滚蛋了！”
秦延军看见是他们两个，走上前说道：“谢谢两位小姐，昨天为我买了盒饭，还给了我钱！”

Yun Mengdie said: "Then you make a phone call for me and tell me that I, Yun Mengdie, want to see her with a beggar!"
The lady at the front desk was surprised; "I seem to have heard that the president is looking for a beggar. Could this be him?"
Thinking of this, I didn't dare to hesitate, ran into the front desk, and dialed the president's office phone number from the landline.
At this time, Wu Moli was sitting at her desk worrying; "Zi Yan, tell me, where has my little junior brother gone? Why didn't he come to me?"
Liu Ziyan smiled slightly and said, "President, don't be anxious. It's only been one night. Maybe it will come at some time today. Don't worry, your health is important!"
"Alas!"
Wu Moli sighed: "Zi Yan, you don't know that when our seniors came down the mountain, they didn't even give 1 penny. I think my juniors will do the same this time. How can you tell me not to worry?"
While the two were talking, the landline phone on the president's desk rang.
Liu Ziyan stepped forward and picked up the microphone: "Hello! This is the president's office! I am Liu Ziyan."
The voice of the receptionist came from the microphone: "Secretary-General Liu, Miss Yun Mengdie, President of Mengdie Group, said that she brought a beggar to see the chairman!"
"Let them come up. Oh, no, I will come down to greet them personally. It's a good reception. Don't offend them!" Liu Ziyan said excitedly.
Liu Ziyan hung up the phone and said hurriedly: "President, Ms. Yun Mengdie, the president of Mengdie Group, brought a beggar and said she wanted to see you. I think it must be your junior brother. I will pick them up now!"
Wu Moli also looked excited, "Okay!"
Liu Ziyan walked out of the office without hesitation.
The lobby on the first floor.
At this time, a business team leader walked in from outside.
"Hey! Isn't this the president of Mengdie Group? Why do you have time to come to our Longwei Group today?" the business team leader said in a strange tone.
Yun Mengdie glanced at him and said coldly: "Whether I come or not has nothing to do with you? You shameless gangster, do you care?"
Hearing Yun Mengdie scolding the business team leader, Qin Yanjun glanced at her. She looked like she was in her mid-twenties, and her skin was fair, but her facial features were a bit out of proportion.
Then he said to Yun Mengdie: "Miss Yun, there is no need to pay attention to this kind of person, he looks like a scumbag."
When the business team leader saw a beggar say that to him, his anger rose: "A stinky beggar dares to say that to me. Are you looking for death? Do you know where this is?"
As soon as he finished speaking, he stepped forward and raised his palm to hit Qin Yanjun in the face.
Yun Mengdie rushed forward: "How dare you! Do you know what the consequences will be if your slap falls?"
After hearing this, the business team leader withdrew his hand: "I, Shen Youjun, am also the business department leader of Longwei Group. Could it be that if I hit someone here, someone else would dare to do something to me?"
At this moment, two beauties walked in from outside.
"Team Leader Shen, do you dare to commit murder in the lobby of Longwei Group? Aren't you afraid that the CEO will find out?" The two beauties who came were Liu Xiaoyan and Lin Xiaoqian, who secretly gave Qin Yanjun money to buy lunch boxes. As soon as they entered the door, they saw Shen Youjun raising his hands to hit someone, and then said those words. Then he saw Qin Yanjun again, so he scolded Shen Youjun.
Shen Youjun saw that he was his salesman, "It turns out it's you two. You are so bold today and dare to scold me. Do you not want to work anymore? I can make you lose your job with just one word. It's also because you two are so beautiful. Maybe one day you will be mine? That's why I keep you until today, otherwise I would have told you to get out!"
When Qin Yanjun saw it was the two of them, he walked up and said, "Thank you ladies for buying me a lunch box yesterday and giving me money!"
